content.syllabus: Fundamental principles of classical mechanics, Lagrangian dynamics, and special relativity.
Schrodinger equation, wave-particle duality, operator algebra, and quantum states.
Electrostatics, magnetostatics, induction, and Maxwell electromagnetic field equations.
Laws of thermodynamics, partition functions, entropy, and statistical ensembles.
Nuclear structure, radioactive decay, elementary particles, and conservation laws.
Reaction mechanisms, stereochemistry, and organic synthesis principles.
Molecular orbital theory, VSEPR model, and crystal field theory.
Multivariable integration, vector analysis, linear transformations, and matrices.
Rigid body dynamics, rotational motion, and gravitation for JEE Advanced.
Mendelian inheritance, molecular genetics, and organ system physiology.
